whetstone-canary.name: Whetstone: lockdown canary
whetstone-canary.description: Run an agent that tries to write the repository and the other protected paths; fail unless every write fails
whetstone-canary.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-claim-check.name: Whetstone: claim check
whetstone-claim-check.description: Quote the claims in the text of the change and judge each K1/K9 claim against the tree the change leaves; write .review/current/claim-check.json. Reads the repository only.
whetstone-claim-check.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-claim-judge.name: Whetstone: claim check, one judge
whetstone-claim-judge.description: One claim-check judge, for one claim; called per claim by whetstone-claim-check so that a judge's failure leaves its claim unjudged instead of stopping the run
whetstone-claim-judge.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-claim-read.name: Whetstone: claim check, one reader
whetstone-claim-read.description: One claim-check reader, for one batch of hunks; called per batch by whetstone-claim-check so that a reader's failure leaves its files unread instead of stopping the run
whetstone-claim-read.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-review.name: Whetstone: review
whetstone-review.description: Review the change with pr-review-toolkit and write .review/current/findings.json (cc-review Findings). Reads the repository only.
whetstone-review.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-shim-check.name: Whetstone: shim check
whetstone-shim-check.description: Decide the defect class, other occurrences and fix strategy of each actionable finding; write .review/current/shim-check.json. Reads the repository only.
whetstone-shim-check.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-triage.name: Whetstone: triage
whetstone-triage.description: Decide with the decision step whether each blocking finding is bikeshedding; write .review/current/triage.json
whetstone-triage.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.description: Review a change with pr-review-toolkit, drop bikeshedding, size each fix, and check every claim its text makes; a report for the person or agent who fixes it. Reads the repository only.
whetstone.author: Kirill Andriychuk
